sn35.59:1.3: “Mendicant, knowing and seeing the eye as not-self, the underlying tendencies are uprooted …
sn35.59:1.12: And also knowing and seeing the pleasant, painful, or neutral feeling that arises dependent on mind contact as not-self, the underlying tendencies are uprooted.
sn35.59:1.13: That’s how to know and see so that the underlying tendencies are uprooted.”
